_about: Future Skills Radar configuration (AI_SIGNAL_SPEC.md). Skills and match patterns, labelling parameters, chart events and source metadata. Parameters are DECLARED design choices, not fitted to data. The market signal comes only from the public sources below; no user data is ever sent to them. Tracked skills and their match patterns live in catalogue/skills.json (trend_tracked: true).

indeed.update_frequency: daily values (7-day trailing average), repository refreshed monthly
caveats: Share of job postings on Indeed that mention AI terms, averaged per month.
Covers 9 countries (AU, CA, DE, FR, GB, IE, IT, NL, US). Malaysia and Singapore are not covered; no chart labels this data as Malaysia.

hn.source: Hacker News “Ask HN: Who is hiring?” (via the Algolia HN Search API)
hn.license: Public API, no key; post text © its authors (only counts are stored)
hn.attribution: Source: Hacker News “Who is hiring?” threads
hn.update_frequency: one thread per month (first weekday of the month)
caveats: Tech hiring signal (Hacker News), not the Malaysian job market.
Skewed toward tech start-ups and US or remote roles; a few hundred posts a month.
One post counts once per skill; mentions are matched by keyword patterns, not read by a person.
